content_of_post_to_comment:
Does anybody need a strict drill sergeant like Accountability Buddy? I'm an overachiever and and I'm looking to help build somebody up and push them into their best era.
Serious inquiries only. You can decide how strict I am, but I'm looking for people who are serious about leveling up or need the structure and discipline.
comment: A strict accountability buddy sounds useful, but I think the real test is whether someone can hold you to your goals without making you dependent on them for motivation. Some days a push helps, other days you need someone to call out when you're taking on too much. Being able to tell the difference is probably what makes this kind of arrangement actually work.
